svg.title: Seaho’ Armed Scout - interpreted silhouette
svg.desc: Traders and Gunboats (2024), printed 16-17, PDF 17-18. Interpreted combined envelope uses long lower fuel deck with concave swept sides, flat narrow nose and wide rectangular rear machinery blocks. Smaller triangular upper deck is aligned aft, consistent with illustration showing bridge behind long nose, and fits within aft envelope. Relative deck placement is inferred; no interior fuel outline holes or detached turrets added.
